name: Aranda de Moncayo (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly and a yellow stripe along the fly, charged with three white drops.
history: Municipal flag of Aranda de Moncayo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the upper hoist to the lower fly
three drops in the upper part
